title: Data Backup | A custom backup made today is restorable and restores into a new sandbox that becomes Ready
notes: Sandbox "QA RT27 restore 2863" restored from backup "custom backup of 2026-11-25 09:48 UTC" (made the same morning).
Status Ready, 4 minutes after the restore started. On 15 Nov it stayed at "creating" (copying_metadata) for over 32 minutes.
Backup (Setup › Data Backup, custom 24–26 Nov, no attachments): completed in 20 s, 271 records, restorable = true, no "made before restore was available" reason; expires 2 Dec.
Restore into a new sandbox accepted (202). Steps: provisioning → copying_identity (177 s) → copying_metadata (200 s) → finishing (232 s) → Ready (242 s), no error.
Not opened: the sandbox itself (it is entered by picking it at login; an API sign-in to it is refused with 403).
